description: This file defines shared data structures, constants, and proxy classes for Android's audio track management, including control blocks, state queues, and client/server proxy classes for audio playback and recording.

classes.name: MirroredVariable
classes.description: Template class for a variable that mirrors its value in shared memory, supporting atomic updates and mirroring across processes.

classes.name: AudioTrackSharedStreaming
classes.description: Structure representing shared streaming state for an audio track.

classes.name: StaticAudioTrackState
classes.description: Structure representing the state of a static (shared memory) audio track.

classes.name: StaticAudioTrackPosLoop
classes.description: Structure for position and loop count info in static audio tracks.

classes.name: AudioTrackSharedStatic
classes.description: Shared static data for audio tracks, including request and position queues.

classes.name: audio_track_cblk_t
classes.description: Control block structure in shared memory for audio tracks, containing state, flags, and control data.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: Base class for shared memory control block proxies, managing access to control block and buffers.

classes.name: ClientProxy
classes.description: Proxy class for clients of audio tracks, providing buffer obtain/release and control functions.

classes.name: AudioTrackClientProxy
classes.description: Client proxy with additional controls for playback rate, volume, and flush.

classes.name: StaticAudioTrackClientProxy
classes.description: Proxy for static (shared memory) audio tracks, supporting loop and position control.

classes.name: AudioRecordClientProxy
classes.description: Proxy for audio record clients, mainly for flushing buffers.

classes.name: ServerProxy
classes.description: Base class for server-side proxies, managing buffer access and synchronization.

classes.name: AudioTrackServerProxy
classes.description: Server proxy for streaming audio tracks, managing underruns, playback rate, and drain state.

classes.name: StaticAudioTrackServerProxy
classes.description: Server proxy for static audio tracks, with support for state updates and underrun handling.

classes.name: AudioRecordServerProxy
classes.description: Server proxy for audio recording, providing buffer availability info.

methods.name: obtainBuffer
methods.description: Method to obtain a buffer for reading or writing audio data.

methods.name: releaseBuffer
methods.description: Method to release frames obtained previously.

methods.name: getStreamEndDone
methods.description: Checks if stream end is marked as done.

methods.name: waitStreamEndDone
methods.description: Waits for stream end to be marked as done.

methods.name: framesReady
methods.description: Returns the number of frames ready for reading/writing.

methods.name: framesReadySafe
methods.description: Returns safe-to-read/write frame count without side effects.

methods.name: framesFlushed
methods.description: Returns total number of frames flushed since creation.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for an audio track.

methods.name: setDrained
methods.description: Sets the drain state of the track buffer.

methods.name: isDrained
methods.description: Checks if the track buffer is drained.

methods.name: getUnderrunFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of underrun frames.

methods.name: getUnderrunCount
methods.description: Returns the count of underrun occurrences.
